artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from two main artifacts: 1) The watermark text is hallucinated/garbled ('isiackpnon'), which is a clear sign of AI generation mimicking stock photos. 2) The leather texture lacks realistic pore detail and appears overly smooth/plastic, and the stitching edges are too sharp/digitally cut.
